reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but does not extract or share the occurrence-to-adjusted-day chain that getUpcomingDates already implements.

duplication.why: The filter-weekend / skip-weekend map / dayFromDate pipeline is copied nearly verbatim from getUpcomingDates in the same file.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered and typed like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its type entry and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and well commented, but a change to how occurrences are weekend-adjusted must now be made in two copies (and it drops the captureBreadcrumb error handling its sibling has).
